title: Georgia's Official Register 1933-1937, consolidated vote of the general election held 1932-11-08

offices.president: President (votes for presidential electors; when each elector is printed, use the column of the elector with the most votes for each party, or the party total if printed); only the 1932 columns: columns for any other year printed beside them are office other
offices.senate: U.S. Senator (regular election only); only the 1932 columns: columns for any other year printed beside them are office other
offices.house: U.S. Representative in Congress, one table per congressional district; only the 1932 columns: columns for any other year printed beside them are office other
